title: Security Harness Finding
description: One vulnerability finding. Written by sh-hunter (status=candidate), enriched by sh-chainer (chained_with), and finalized by sh-verifier (status + poc + cvss). One JSON object per line in findings.jsonl / verified.jsonl.

id.description: Stable unique id, format SH-<CLASS>-<NNN>, e.g. SH-SQLI-001. Assigned by the hunter; never reused.

class.description: Vulnerability class slug, matching an sh-kb-* skill (e.g. 'sqli', 'access-control', 'ssrf').

cvss.description: Optional CVSS v3.1 scoring. Filled by the verifier.

cwe.description: One or more CWE ids, e.g. ["CWE-89"].

file.description: Repo-relative path to the primary sink.

line.description: Primary line number of the sink.

sink.description: The dangerous operation the tainted data reaches (file:line + description).

data_flow.description: Ordered taint path from source to sink. Each step is a hop through the code.

note.description: What happens to the tainted value at this hop (e.g. 'concatenated into query', 'no sanitization applied').

why_it_matters.description: Impact and failure mode: what an attacker gains, not merely what is wrong.

payload.description: Concrete probe/exploit payload string (curated from the class KB, adapted to this sink).

poc.description: Reproduction steps or a runnable snippet/curl the verifier used or would use to confirm exploitability.

confidence.description: 0-100. Hunter's initial confidence; verifier overwrites with post-verification confidence.

status.description: candidate=hunter-reported, unverified. verified=verifier confirmed exploitable from evidence. false-positive=verifier refuted. needs-runtime=plausible but requires a running target/credentials to confirm.

verification.description: Verifier's reasoning. Present when status != candidate.

rationale.description: Why the verdict holds: which guard is missing/present, why the sanitizer fails, etc.

reproduced.description: True only if the verifier statically constructed a complete, unbroken source->sink exploit path.

chained_with.description: Finding ids this combines with in an escalation chain (see chains.md). Empty if standalone.

mitigation.description: Specific, code-level remediation (parameterize this query, add this authz check), not generic advice.

evidence.description: The exact code snippet(s) supporting the finding, with file:line anchors.

pre_existing.description: True if the issue exists in code not changed by the reviewed diff (whole-repo scans set false/omit).
